nodes.title: AVL 3.52 vortex-lattice code (Drela, Youngren)
nodes.where: avl_doc.txt: geometry, CONTROL, ST and MODE output

nodes.title: MH 45 coordinates, UIUC airfoil database
nodes.where: 67 points; t/c 9.85 % recomputed from the file (team/B3/avl/mh45.dat)

nodes.title: Ribner, Propellers in yaw, NACA Report 820 (1945)
Perkins & Hage, Airplane Performance, Stability and Control (1949)
nodes.where: ch. 5: propeller normal force dCN/dalpha = 4.25 sigma_e/(1+2 sigma_e) sin(beta+8 deg) f(Tc)

nodes.title: MIL-F-8785C Flying qualities of piloted airplanes (1980)
nodes.where: 3.2.2.1.2 short-period damping >= 0.35 (Level 1, cat. B); 3.3.4 roll performance

nodes.title: Hoerner, Fluid-Dynamic Drag / Lift (1965/1985)
nodes.where: flat plate normal force at 90 deg, CN ~1.17-1.2 for low aspect ratio

nodes.title: Viscous cm shift of the MH 45
nodes.text: Section cm (viscous, Re 3e5) minus thin-airfoil cm on the MH 45 camber line, added to AVL's Cm
nodes.basis: team/B3/xfoil/summary.json (XFOIL Re 3e5, Ncrit 9, cl 0.3-0.7): cm -0.0092 vs thin +0.0063. Hepperle's published +0.0145 would give +0.008: B2 settles it; S-AND-C.md shows both

nodes.title: Elevon effectiveness factor
nodes.text: Real elevon lift/moment per degree = this factor x AVL (thin-airfoil) value, for up-deflections
nodes.basis: XFOIL plain flap at 0.78 c, Re 3e5: 0.69 (-5 deg) to 0.59 (-15 deg), mean 0.63; down 0.80-0.84

nodes.title: Propeller normal-force slope
nodes.text: dCN/dalpha of one 11x4.5MR prop, on its disk area and freestream q, lightly loaded
nodes.basis: Perkins & Hage with sigma_e 0.09 (2 blades, ~20 mm chord at 0.75 R), beta_0.75 = 9.8 deg, f(Tc) ~1.1: 0.10 per rad. Uncertainty +/-50 %

nodes.title: Upwash factor at the props
nodes.text: 1 + d(eps_u)/d(alpha) at the prop planes
nodes.basis: props 0.05-0.15 m ahead of the LE but 0.19 m off the wing plane; DATCOM upwash chart ~1.1-1.2

nodes.title: Cross-flow CD of tubes and motors
nodes.text: CD of the 22 mm tubes and the motor cans normal to their axis
nodes.basis: circular cylinder, subcritical Re ~2e4: 1.0-1.2 (Hoerner)

nodes.title: Pod Munk factor
nodes.text: Fraction of the slender-body destabilising moment the pod gives, sitting on the wing upper surface
nodes.basis: half-body on a wall ~0.5 (image); ESTIMATE

nodes.title: Elevon travel allowed for pitch trim
nodes.text: At the trimmed CLmax the pitch-trim elevon may use at most this much of the 25 deg travel
nodes.basis: leaves 15 deg (60 %) for roll and gust correction; B3 choice

nodes.title: Minimum roll helix angle
nodes.text: pb/2V at full available differential, at the trimmed stall
nodes.basis: small-UAV practice from MIL-F-8785C class I roll times: pb/2V >= 0.07

nodes.title: Minimum directional stability
nodes.text: Cn_beta of the whole aircraft in cruise, per rad
nodes.basis: positive weathercock stability with ~0.02 margin for the prop term uncertainty; B3 choice

nodes.title: Control power over disturbance
nodes.text: Available control moment / disturbance moment, per axis
nodes.basis: control power at least twice the 5 m/s disturbance; B3 choice, common VTOL practice

nodes.title: Flat-plate normal force at 90 deg
nodes.text: CN of the wing broadside and the fins broadside
nodes.basis: Hoerner: 1.17 (AR 1-5); used 1.2

nodes.title: Wing centre of pressure, wind on the face
nodes.text: x_cp/c of the wing normal force at 70-90 deg incidence
nodes.basis: flat plate 0.40-0.50 c; 0.45 used

nodes.title: Spanwise gust asymmetry in hover
nodes.text: Fraction of the wing normal force acting as a left-right difference at b/4
nodes.basis: ESTIMATE for a 1.15 m span in turbulent 5 m/s wind

nodes.title: Wing profile drag for the transition model
nodes.text: CD0 of the wing + fins + pod
nodes.basis: B1 owns the drag build-up; 0.020 at Re 3e5 (MH 45 cd ~0.008, fins, pod, tubes)

nodes.title: Pitch differential allowed in transition
nodes.text: Fraction of the motors' pitch differential the quasi-steady transition may use
nodes.basis: keeps 40 % for pitch rate, gusts and roll/yaw mixing; B3 choice

nodes.title: Elevon pitch travel in transition
nodes.text: Elevon deflection available for pitch during the transition
nodes.basis: 25 deg travel less 10 deg kept for roll; B3 choice

nodes.title: Elevon effectiveness at 90 deg
nodes.text: Elevon effectiveness behind the fully stalled wing relative to attached flow (linear in alpha between)
nodes.basis: flap behind separated flow keeps ~20-30 % (Hoerner, Fluid-Dynamic Lift ch. 5); ESTIMATE

nodes.title: Sideslip disturbance for yaw authority
nodes.text: Sideslip the yaw control must hold against
nodes.basis: 5 m/s crosswind gust at 15 m/s ~ 18 deg; 10 deg used for a sustained case

nodes.title: Allowed hover pitch-trim split
nodes.text: Upper/lower pair thrust ratio for hover pitch trim
nodes.basis: split s uses (s-1)/2 of the pitch differential; 1.25 uses 12.5 %, replaces A3's 1.10 placeholder

nodes.title: Short-period damping minimum
nodes.text: Level 1 short-period damping ratio
nodes.basis: MIL-F-8785C cat. B Level 1

nodes.title: AVL lattice convergence
nodes.equation: Xnp, Cm_de at alpha 4 deg on coarse / medium / fine lattices; d = |fine - medium|

nodes.title: AVL longitudinal derivatives
nodes.equation: AVL fine lattice, alpha 4 deg, controls 0: CLa, Xnp, Cm_np = Cm_ref + CL (Xnp - xref)/c, control derivatives per deg (thin-airfoil)

nodes.title: AVL neutral point grid change
nodes.how: Re-run sc_analysis.py with the cache deleted; compare coarse/medium/fine in results/sc_results.json.

nodes.title: Neutral point, wing and fins
nodes.how: AVL fine lattice; cross-check: flat plate AR 3.8 with end-plate fins, NP ~0.23 c.

nodes.title: Lift-curve slope, AVL
nodes.how: Twin glide: alpha from the FC vs CL from airspeed and mass.

nodes.title: Neutral point with props and pod
nodes.equation: Cma about Xnp_aero: dCm_p = n cna A/S up (Xnp_a - x_p)/c ; dCm_pod = 2 k V/(S c), V = 0.6 LWH ; Xnp = Xnp_a - (dCm_p + dCm_pod)/(CLa + dCLa_p) c

nodes.title: Neutral point, whole aircraft
nodes.how: Twin and aircraft: elevon trim vs CG at two pack positions in FBWA glides; Xnp where the trim-vs-CL slope is zero (MIT 16.06 method).

nodes.title: Cm about the NP, AVL thin
nodes.how: Follows from AVL; the viscous shift ASM-B3-DCM-VISC is added in each trim calculation.

nodes.title: Elevon lift per degree, AVL
nodes.how: Twin: CL change per degree of trim in level glide.

nodes.title: Elevon pitch moment per degree, AVL
nodes.how: Twin: pitch-rate response to an elevon step (FC log), fitted.

nodes.title: CG limits from stability and trim
nodes.equation: aft: x = Xnp - SMmin c ; forward: SM where the elevon trim at the trimmed CLmax reaches the trim budget (Cm_ac - CL SM + Cmd delta = 0, CL = CLmax + CLd delta) ; target = mid-range

nodes.title: Aft CG limit
nodes.how: H1 CG balance on the two fin-root marks; never fly with the balance point aft of this line.

nodes.title: Forward CG limit
nodes.how: H1 CG balance; twin: full-up trim margin at slow flight (elevon <= 10 deg up at the stall warning).

nodes.title: CG design target
nodes.how: A3 roll-up and H1 balance with the pack centred in its slide.

nodes.title: Static margin at the CG target
nodes.how: Twin and aircraft: elevon-trim-vs-CL slope at two CG positions (FBWA glides).

nodes.title: Current CG against the B3 range
nodes.equation: x_now = cg_frac c ; margin = x_now - x_fwd ; move to target = x_t - x_now

nodes.title: Current CG behind the forward limit
nodes.how: Re-run after A3 updates the roll-up; H1 balance on the built aircraft.

nodes.title: Trimmed stall and transition speed at the gate
nodes.equation: CLmax_t = CLmax + CLd eff delta, delta from Cm = 0 ; Vs = sqrt(2 m g / (rho S CLmax_t)) ; Vt = k Vs

nodes.title: Trimmed stall speed at the gate, CG target
nodes.how: Twin, then aircraft at 2.6 kg: FBWA slow-flight to the stall break with airspeed logging, CG on target.

nodes.title: Transition speed from the trimmed stall
nodes.how: Set ARSPD_FBW_MIN >= this; flight log of the first transition (H2).

nodes.title: Trim across speeds (target CG)
nodes.equation: CL = 2 m g/(rho V^2 S) ; delta = (CL SM - Cm_ac)/Cmd_eff ; alpha = alpha0 + (CL - CLd_eff delta)/CLa

nodes.title: Zero-lift angle, AVL
nodes.how: Follows from AVL with the MH 45 camber line.

nodes.title: Elevon trim at 15 m/s, CG target
nodes.how: FBWA level flight at 15 m/s: servo output vs neutral (FC log).

nodes.title: Body angle at 15 m/s
nodes.how: FC pitch angle in level flight at 15 m/s (no wind).

nodes.title: Roll authority at the trimmed stall
nodes.equation: da = travel - budget ; pb/2V = Cld eff da / |Clp| ; tau = Ixx / (|Clp| q S b^2 / 2V) ; t60 from first-order roll response

nodes.title: Elevon roll moment per degree, AVL
nodes.how: Twin: roll-rate response to a differential elevon step.

nodes.title: Roll damping, AVL
nodes.how: Twin: roll-rate decay after a step (time constant).

nodes.title: Roll helix angle at the trimmed stall
nodes.how: Twin at 1.1 Vs: full-stick roll, FC roll rate; pb/2V = p b / 2V.

nodes.title: Time to 60 deg bank at the stall
nodes.how: Twin roll test, FC log.

nodes.title: Elevon area fraction, upper bound
nodes.equation: A = 2 (span_in + span_out) f c ; frac = A/S

nodes.title: Elevon area within the upper bound
nodes.how: Measure the cut panels; freeze after the twin's trim and roll tests.

nodes.title: Directional and lateral stability, cruise
nodes.equation: Cnb = Cnb_AVL(wing+fins, at CG target) + Cnb_props (Ribner) + Cnb_tubes/motors (drag rotation)

nodes.title: Directional stability Cn_beta, cruise
nodes.how: Twin in FBWA with yaw assist off: rudder-free yaw doublet (differential thrust pulse); heading must return. Wind-tunnel-free check: hang the airframe on a vertical pivot at the CG in a car-top run.

nodes.title: Rigid-body modes at 15 m/s (linear, props included)
nodes.equation: Etkin small-perturbation 4x4 longitudinal (u,w,q,theta) and lateral (v,p,r,phi) state matrices from the AVL derivatives; Cma = -CLa SM (props included); eigenvalues by Faddeev-LeVerrier

nodes.title: Short-period damping ratio, 15 m/s
nodes.how: Twin: elevon doublet in MANUAL, pitch-rate overshoot.

nodes.title: Lateral-directional divergence, time to double
nodes.how: Twin, yaw assist off, at altitude: sideslip/heading drift after a yaw pulse (FC log).
nodes.note: MIL-F-8785C spiral limit (>= 4 s to double, Level 2 >= 8 s for Level 1 cat. B was 20 s); a directional divergence faster than this must be stabilised actively

nodes.title: Cruise yaw control by differential thrust
nodes.equation: N_req = |Cnb| beta q S b ; T_m = m g /(L/D) / 4 ; dT = min(T_m, Tmax sag g - T_m) ; N_av = 4 dT y (total thrust held)

nodes.title: Cruise yaw: motor authority / instability
nodes.how: F4 maps yaw to left/right differential thrust in FW (SITL, then twin yaw doublets).

nodes.title: Hover control power vs 5 m/s wind
nodes.equation: dT = min(T_lower, Tmax sag - T_upper) per motor ; M_pitch = 2 dT (2 z) ; M_roll = 4 dT y ; M_yaw = 4 dT (kq swirl + r sin cant), kq = Q_hover/T_hover (B4) ; disturbance: q S CN90 arm (pitch), fins (roll), asym F b/4 (yaw)

nodes.title: Hover pitch control power / 5 m/s wind
nodes.how: Twin, then aircraft: hover in 5 m/s; FC log of motor outputs - none may saturate (H2).

nodes.title: Hover roll control power / 5 m/s wind
nodes.how: Twin, then aircraft: hover in 5 m/s; FC log of motor outputs - none may saturate (H2).

nodes.title: Hover yaw control power / 5 m/s wind
nodes.how: Twin, then aircraft: hover in 5 m/s; FC log of motor outputs - none may saturate (H2).

nodes.title: Hover yaw power / wind, 3 deg motor cant
nodes.how: Bench: yaw torque on a turntable with canted mounts; hover yaw steps (H2).
nodes.note: Applies once D3 cants the motor mounts 3 deg tangentially (CR-B4-04); without cant the yaw claim fails

nodes.title: Hover pitch-trim share
nodes.equation: share of the pitch differential used by trim = (s - 1)/2

nodes.title: Allowed hover trim share
nodes.how: B3 choice (ASM-B3-SPLIT-MAX); F4 checks motor outputs in a hover log.

nodes.title: Hover pitch-trim share of the differential
nodes.how: Hover log: mean upper vs lower motor output (RCOU), H2.

nodes.title: Elevons in the hover slipstream?
nodes.equation: gap = (z - D/(2 sqrt 2)) - (t/2 + ef c sin(defl)) ; > 0: elevon outside the contracted wash

nodes.title: Elevon to hover slipstream gap
nodes.how: Tuft or ribbon on the elevon in a tethered hover: if it does not stream, the elevons give no hover yaw.
nodes.note: Positive: the elevons sit outside the props' contracted wash, so hover yaw comes from rotor torque only

nodes.title: Quasi-steady transition pitch balance
nodes.equation: level flight at V: T cos a = D, T sin a + L = W ; wing CP from Xnp (attached) to 0.5 c at 90 deg ; props' normal force at x_prop ; use = |M_aero| / (2 dT 2z), dT = min(T/4, Tmax sag - T/4)

nodes.title: Transition: pitch differential used, worst
nodes.how: SITL with the AVL/flat-plate aero table (F4); then twin transitions: RCOU of upper vs lower pair stays below 80 % of range.

nodes.title: CG balance at the limits
nodes.procedure: H1: balance the ready-to-fly aircraft on two fingertips (or a knife-edge jig) at the fin roots; the balance line must lie between the two marks drawn at the B3 limits.

nodes.title: Twin neutral point from glides
nodes.procedure: Twin, FBWA glides at 3 speeds for 2 pack positions; plot elevon trim vs CL; Xnp where the slope is 0.

nodes.title: Twin FW yaw doublet
nodes.procedure: Twin in FBWA at 15 m/s, 50 m AGL: yaw pulse by differential thrust; with assist off, record heading and sideslip divergence; with assist on, it must return within 2 s.

nodes.title: Hover authority in wind
nodes.procedure: Tethered then free hover at 5 m/s measured wind; no motor output above 85 % or below 10 % (RCOU).
